history.title: Events in India · phase begins
history.report:
Storm die: All three seas. Resolve 1 India event after storms.

In West Indian Ocean, South Indian Ocean, East Indian Ocean, roll one physical die per ship except Company ships and Extra ships.

Ships assigned to the Superintendent of Trade in China count as being in the East Indian Ocean for storms.

1–2: no effect.

3–4: fatigue the ship. If it was already fatigued, it sinks.

5–6: the ship sinks.

Return sunk ships to their shipyards, flipped to their non-fatigued side. Resolve all ship rolls before drawing the first India event.

The chronicle closes on turn 5: Final turn completed.

Complete final prize upkeep if not already done, skip refresh, and resolve Final Scoring on the physical board.

After Final Scoring, the player with the most victory points wins. Break ties by most window icons, then clockwise order starting with the Prime Minister.

Final Company territory: none. Company regions lost this turn: 0.

The final map, event stack and campaign record are preserved. Gameplay is closed; Undo reopens the game. Export a JSON backup from Saved games to keep the chronicle.
